summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by a handful of frontier families — OpenAI's GPT series, Anthropic's Claude, and Google's Gemini — with strong open-weight competition from Meta's Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Alibaba's Qwen. Real-world adoption is increasingly shaped by enterprise aggregator reach (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which amplifies usage well beyond direct-API numbers. Because some sources cite speculative or unreleased version numbers (e.g. GPT-6, Gemini 4, DeepSeek V4), this ranking conservatively uses only model names confirmed as publicly available today.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Consistently the most-used model across developer surveys and API traffic, with massive enterprise reach via Azure OpenAI Service and broad third-party integration.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications and multimodal assistants

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Leading adoption through Google Vertex AI and Workspace integration, cited across research as a top-tier frontier model with an industry-leading context window.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and enterprise Google Cloud deployments

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Dominant in coding and agentic workflows, with heavy enterprise adoption via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex.
models.best_for: Software development, agents, and enterprise knowledge work

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume adoption for cost-sensitive, high-throughput workloads via Vertex AI, frequently paired with Pro for tiered deployments.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: The most-downloaded open-weight model family on HuggingFace, widely self-hosted and available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A breakout open-weight reasoning model with very high HuggingFace download volume and strong cost advantages driving rapid developer adoption.
strengths: Competitive with frontier models on math/code

models.name: o3
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's flagship reasoning model adopted for complex analytical and coding tasks, available via the OpenAI API and Azure.
strengths: Strong on math, science, and coding
models.best_for: Complex reasoning, research, and hard problem-solving

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Cited across multiple 2026 roundups as a leading open-weight general model with strong adoption due to very low cost and solid benchmark performance.
models.best_for: Affordable general-purpose and coding workloads at scale

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: A top open-weight model from Alibaba with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads and strong multilingual adoption, cited as a top-9 model in recent research.

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Europe's leading model with notable enterprise adoption via Azure and AWS Bedrock, favored for data-sovereignty-conscious deployments.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Fast, low-cost member of the Claude family seeing growing high-volume adoption via AWS Bedrock and Vertex AI, clustering closely with #10 in usage.
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive production tasks needing Claude quality
